subject: german
title: Bildung und Arbeit
welcome_lead: Social Organization includes education and work. Germany's dual system (Duales System) is famous worldwide.
final_note: How society educates is how it imagines its future.

walkthroughs.body_html: Grundschule, Hauptschule, Realschule, Gymnasium. The Gymnasium prepares for Abitur and university.
Apprentices split time between Berufsschule and a company. The system trains 60% of German youth and underpins low youth unemployment.
For 'bereitet die Schule auf das Arbeitsleben vor?', use einerseits. andererseits and conclude with reform suggestions.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I get up early' using 'aufstehen'?
Why can you not just ignore umlauts in German?
options: They are pronounced the same as without dots.
They change the pronunciation AND meaning of words.
